'''XR-53''' was a corrupted [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] created by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] with the ability to repair itself by harvesting resources.<ref name="Recap">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20241114-0|text=Game Update 7.6 "Galactic Threads" Recap}}</ref> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> XR-53 was present on the ruins of the [[Emperor's Fortress]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] after its destruction during the [[Battle of Ilum]].<ref name="Operation" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Propagator Core XR-53 is a lair boss first appeared in the Game Update 7.6 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Recap" /> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
